mission: Owner decision 2026-11-17 ('go both'). (1) Approved RED work: policy-gate passes a RED mission only when owner_approvals links the owner's approval for every RED category, it declares RED and meets every AMBER safeguard; its output owner_merge_only=true makes staging-pr-live report the PR as not current and staging-automerge refuse to arm it, so only the owner merges it by hand. It may not change collector runtime inputs or request a rollout or RAW migration (a hand merge runs neither). Production stays unapprovable. The link documents the approval; the hand merge is the control. (2) staging-automerge fails fast when the PR is behind staging or in conflict (mergeable_state behind or dirty), before arming and on every wait poll, instead of timing out after 30 minutes (#294). Opened by Claude: it is the gate on the engineer's own PRs; labelled hold-for-owner, the owner merges. policy-gate runs the base branch's policy, so this PR is evaluated by today's policy and RED takes effect only after merge.

impacts.reason: RED evaluation: approval links per RED category (owner_approvals), RED declared, AMBER safeguards required, owner_merge_only output, no rollout or RAW migration request, no collector runtime change (checked with collector_runtime_inputs). Production refused as before; missing or malformed approvals refused as before.

policy-gate exports owner_merge_only; staging-pr-live reports approved RED as not current; staging-automerge refuses it as a second guard; arming and the wait loop stop at once on mergeable_state behind or dirty. Triggers, permissions, environments and secrets unchanged.

Approved RED passes but is owner_merge_only; every RED category needs a valid GitHub link; RED still needs every other check; no rollout or migration request; GREEN and AMBER never owner_merge_only; workflow guards for RED arming and fail-fast present in both places.
Approved RED work and fail-fast described; decision recorded.

resources: policy-gate classification of PRs to staging
routes: None: CI tooling and docs only; no API, web or collector route
dependencies: staging 4a2aae43 or later; no open PR must merge first
impact.deployment_impact: No service, collector, fleet or schema change. GREEN and AMBER PRs are evaluated exactly as before; RED missions that were always refused can now pass only with approval links and are never armed. A PR behind staging or in conflict now fails its delivery job at once instead of after 30 minutes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file restores the previous policy and wait loop.
recovery.trigger: A RED PR is armed or merged by CI, a GREEN or AMBER PR is refused that passed before, or a current PR fails fast wrongly.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The next PR to staging (policy-gate output owner_merge_only=false, normal arming) and the first approved RED PR (#293's successor): policy-gate passes, staging-automerge does not arm, the owner merges by hand.
